entries.text: A sentence is to be executed speedily.
One found guilty of breaking the law can be confined or placed under guard until execution of sentence.
Slay not the innocent or the righteous.
Punishment executed by a state executioner (revenger of blood).
Punishment administered by the people (the men of the city).
Punishment by officer of the court.
You shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death, but he shall surely be put to death (no parole or prison sentence).
If one is hanged, his body shall not remain overnight on the tree, but you shall bury him that day.
No punishment allowed by lynch mobs.
No pity is to be given in the execution of punishment.
Those guilty of transgressing the law are to be rebuked and punished in the presence of all the people, so that others may be fearful of sinning.
